capabilities: Track reading progress with a percentage bar per note
Show a heading outline that follows scrolling and jumps to headings
Scrub and navigate the document by dragging a text-density rail
Jump back to the last reading position when reopening a note
extras: The README warns that its view adapters depend on Obsidian's DOM and may need maintenance after app updates. Supports Chinese and English UI. Beta builds are available via BRAT (yunmin311/reading-rail-sidebar-obsidian). No network access; positions stored locally in data.json.
intentEvidence: It replaces the native scrollbar (which the plugin hides)
motivation: The author notes that dense stretches of a long note are usually where the reader was, and exactly the part that cannot be found again next session, so the panel puts position, structure and density in one place.
problem: Obsidian's outline shows structure and the scrollbar shows a percentage, but neither shows where a note is dense or helps you return to the exact spot you stopped reading.
summary: Sidebar panel that tracks reading progress in a note with a scroll-following heading outline, a text-density rail replacing the scrollbar, and per-file resume positions.
